name: Mountbatten
summary: East-central CCL stop near Old Airport Road / stadium edges — food density, sports adjacency, and condo/HDB mix with shorter CBD hops than far-east towns.
body: Mountbatten is the shortlist when Circle Line access and Old Airport Road food matter, with stadium / indoor sports gravity nearby toward Kallang. Housing mixes condos, walk-ups, and older estate edges; event evenings and weekend food crowds are the tax. Expats land here for CCL hops and lifestyle density rather than quiet cul-de-sac living. Compare with Nicoll Highway for a slightly more Kallang Basin / city-fringe feel, Aljunied for NEL heartland texture, and Dakota when you want to be tighter to Old Airport Road itself.
